summary: One actionable coverage regression found in explain_growth. The inspected lifecycle-summary path otherwise avoids decoding private traversal progress, disables export-inventory refresh, and leaves unprojected historical counters unknown. Static review only.

findings.claim: [P2] explain_growth can now report complete coverage while an overlapping scan generation is incomplete. Switching to lifecycleSummary removes the synthetic active-root gaps formerly supplied by lifecycleStatus, but explainGrowth still calculates coverage solely from status.observationGaps. With an active pending generation and no persisted gaps, the lifecycle endpoint reports partial through detailCoverage while explain_growth incorrectly reports complete.
findings.recommendation: Merge active-generation coverage from the bounded scalar projection into explain_growth, preserving requested-window overlap semantics without reading private progress. Add real-IPC regressions for a window overlapping an active incomplete generation and a disjoint historical window.
